statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir_name=$(basename "$current_dir"); git_branch=""; if git -C "$current_dir" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$current_dir" -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false -c core.fsmonitor=false symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$current_dir" -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false -c core.fsmonitor=false rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && git_branch=" $branch"; fi; printf "%s%s" "$dir_name" "$git_branch"
